heading: Resolving NPS Issues: A Guide to PFRDA Pension Sahayak
tldr: The PFRDA Pension Sahayak portal offers a streamlined online platform for National Pension System (NPS) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY) subscribers to raise and track grievances.
This dedicated portal simplifies the complaint registration process, making it easier to report issues like incorrect contributions or scheme changes.
Subscribers can monitor the status of their complaints directly on the platform, providing transparency and reducing follow-up efforts.
If a complaint remains unresolved, the portal outlines clear escalation mechanisms to ensure timely redressal.
Utilising Pension Sahayak helps ensure your NPS account details are accurate and any discrepancies are addressed efficiently, safeguarding your retirement savings.
caption:
Ever faced a problem with your NPS or APY account and wondered how to fix it? It can feel confusing! Good news: PFRDA has a simple online tool called Pension Sahayak. It helps you easily report issues like wrong contributions and track them until they're sorted. This makes sure your retirement savings are safe and sound. Learn how to use it in our article.
